name: Mayflower Inn & Spa, Auberge Collection
positioning: Country inn in the Litchfield Hills of Connecticut, set in 58 acres of gardens and woodland, with a large wellness destination
best_for: Travelers who want a countryside retreat in Connecticut with a large wellness destination

facts.text: Mayflower Inn & Spa is at 118 Woodbury Road in Washington, Connecticut, in the Litchfield Hills.
The property sits in 58 acres of landscaped gardens and woodland.
Accommodation is in an English country house style main building plus three standalone cottages.
The Retreat is the hotel's 20,000-square-foot holistic wellness destination.
The Retreat offers facials by Biologique Recherche.
Guests have an outdoor pool and an indoor spa pool.
Interior designer Celerie Kemble designed the current interiors.
The Garden Room is known for its mirrored latticework.
The Tap Room serves pub fare.
The hotel has a garden that supplies ingredients to its dining.
Guest activities include hiking through meadows and wetlands, and an evening bonfire with s'mores.
The hotel is pet-friendly; guests should contact it directly for current pet policies.

considerations.text: The hotel is approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes from Bradley International Airport near Hartford.
WhataHotel notes that the rural Connecticut location requires a car to explore the area.
